The '''Forward alien camp''' was an alien-crewed outpost of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Eastern Ice Shelf]] of [[Ilum]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]] in the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Forward alien camp appears as an area on Ilum in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
